properties.name: customRender
properties.type: ({ close, open }: { close: () => void; open: () => void }) => ReactNode

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: 每次选择时(如组件内部TableSelect点击选择时)都会触发

properties.name: onOk
properties.description: 这里需要用any去最大化onOk的参数和返回值范围，以便做扩展

properties.name: visible
properties.description: 传入number类型时将被转换为 `Boolean(visible)`，modal将会变得不受控

properties.name: title
properties.description: 弹出框的标题（设置为 null 时，不显示标题栏）

properties.name: footer
properties.description: 自定义按钮确认和取消按钮，为 null 的话没有按钮组

properties.name: width
properties.description: 抽屉的宽度，`placement`为 `left` `right` 时生效

properties.name: height
properties.description: 抽屉的高度，`placement`为 `top` `bottom` 时生效

properties.name: closable
properties.description: 是否显示右上角关闭按钮

properties.name: closeIcon
properties.description: 自定义右上角关闭按钮

properties.name: maskClosable
properties.description: 点击蒙层是否可以关闭

properties.name: confirmLoading
properties.description: 确认按钮是否为加载中状态

properties.name: mountOnEnter
properties.description: 是否在初次打开对话框时才渲染 dom。

properties.name: unmountOnExit
properties.description: 是否在隐藏的时候销毁 DOM 结构

properties.name: getPopupContainer
properties.description: 指定弹出框挂载的父节点

properties.name: getChildrenPopupContainer
properties.description: 抽屉里的弹出框 `Select` `Tooltip` 等挂载的容器，默认挂载在对话框内。

properties.name: autoFocus
properties.description: 是否默认聚焦第一个可聚焦元素，只在 `focusLock` 开启时生效。

properties.name: focusLock
properties.description: 是否将焦点锁定在弹出框内。

properties.name: showDefaultFooter
properties.description: 单选模式下是否展示默认footer

properties.name: contentTop
properties.description: 弹窗内容部分上部插入齐边内容

properties.name: contentBottom
properties.description: 弹窗内容部分下部插入齐边内容

RowKeyConfig
doclets.type: export type RowKeyConfig<DataItemType> = keyof DataItemType | ((record: DataItemType, index: number) => string);

doclets.name: ToolbarItemGroup
doclets.type: export type ToolbarItemGroup<T extends R = any, GlobalScopeType extends R = any> = AllowEmpty<ToolbarItemConfig<T, GlobalScopeType>>[];
